input_variants.name: empty_input
input_variants.diagnostic: Empty input detected; no processing performed.

edge_cases.trigger: job_id matches exactly one record in artifact_failure_jobs

edge_cases.description: Record matching multiple input variants (e.g., timestamp from both cert rotation and failure jobs)
edge_cases.trigger: timestamp matches both certificate_rotation_event and artifact_failure_jobs

edge_cases.description: Record not matching any input variant
edge_cases.trigger: None of the input variants match the record's timestamp/region combination
edge_cases.diagnostic: No matching input variant detected; processing halted.

filtering.name: certificate_version_validation
filtering.trigger: event_time matches start of incident window (2023-10-01T09:00:00Z)

filtering.name: artifact_signature_verification
filtering.trigger: deployment_job exists in artifact_failure_jobs AND certificate_version is valid

filtering.name: region_staggering
filtering.trigger: event_time falls within regional deployment windows (6-hour staggered)

filtering.name: coincident_change_exclusion
filtering.trigger: external_event timestamp matches within 30 minutes of any incident event

normalization.name: signature_hash_conversion
normalization.trigger: signature_value exists AND is not empty

interpolation.name: certificate_bundle_cache
interpolation.trigger: event_time falls within 600-second cache window (10 minutes)

ambiguous_source_resolution.trigger: primary_source and fallback_source both exist for ambiguous records

coincidental_change_handling.trigger: external_change_id matches within 30 minutes of incident events

invariants.name: temporal_correlation_validation
invariants.description: All event_time fields must be within the 62-minute incident window (2023-10-01T09:00:00Z to 2023-10-01T09:42:00Z)

invariants.name: certificate_version_integrity
invariants.description: All certificate versions must be valid (v1.4.2 to v1.5.0) and match the rotation event

invariants.name: signature_verification
invariants.description: All artifact signatures must match expected certificate bundles or be flagged as invalid

ordering.name: event_time_sorting
ordering.description: Records must be sorted by event_time in ascending order for all processing steps

ordering.name: region_staggering
ordering.description: Regional deployments must process staggered windows (6-hour intervals) in chronological order

rounding.name: timestamp_precision
rounding.description: All timestamps rounded to nearest second with UTC timezone

rounding.name: signature_hash_format
rounding.description: Signature values converted to hexadecimal format for consistency

serialization.name: json_structure
serialization.description: Output must maintain exact JSON structure with all required fields present and no extra keys

serialization.name: numeric_units
serialization.description: All numeric values must include appropriate units in field labels (e.g., 'seconds' for duration)

out_of_scope.reason: The artifact does not include analysis of unrelated coincident changes beyond exclusion criteria
out_of_scope.scope_discipline: Scope discipline requires focusing on primary evidence; coincidental events are excluded as per supplied material.

out_of_scope.reason: No additional remediation items beyond those derived from the incident window and certificate rotation event
out_of_scope.scope_discipline: Remediation must address process (e.g., certificate cache validation) and technology (e.g., signature verification).

terminology.definition: Version identifier for internal certificate bundles used by deployment jobs. Must match rotation event.
Deployment job outcome: either 'FAILED' or 'PASSED'. Used to identify affected deployments.

hand-off_checklist.sign_off: Must validate all input variants and processing rules before proceeding.
Must confirm all validation checks and edge case handling are implemented.
Must verify all reproducibility constraints and scope omissions are documented.
